description: Demonstration train timetable and fare model. Not an RZD tariff or a sale offer.
distance_status: synthetic modelling input, not measured rail routing
traveler_policy: Every listed person occupies one seat; no age discount is claimed. Pets incur a modelled fee but actual carriage eligibility is unknown.
point_note: Rounded station gateway coordinates retained from D1 draft; Yandex station codes are independent of the IATA city alias used by D1.

sources.title: Yandex Timetables: search between points
sources.scope: API request/response schema and city-code example c146 to c213, not a captured timetable.
